{{nihongo|'''Tsukima Shrine'''|月間神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Teishi, {{ill|Minamiizu|Q1203741|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401084 月間神社] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>. {{nihongo|'''Tsukima Shrine'''|月間神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is enshrined in the center of the Teishi district on the west bank of the Aono River, in southeastern Minamiizu.

Its foundation is said to be in the {{ill|Kashō|Q1373157|qid=Q1373157}} era (848-851), and it is an old shrine identified with one of the three seats of the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Takama Shrine''' (たかま / つくまの じんじゃ), with deity {{ill|Mishima Taisha|Q650772|qid=Q650772|lt=Mishima Daimyōjin}} ({{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611}}), and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkai-chō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as “Senior Fourth Rank Upper, Tsukima no Myōjin”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/tukima_title.htm 月間神社] - Genshōshi</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140142-01.html 月間神社] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

Tradition says that after a major eruption occurred on {{ill|Kōzu-shima|Q301669|qid=Q301669}} around {{ill|Jōwa (Heian period)|Q1075605|qid=Q1075605|lt=Jōwa}} 5 ({{ill|838|Q23838|qid=Q23838}}), a distant-worship site was established here. Mishima Daimyōjin (Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto) was enshrined here; his principal consort Awanome-no-Mikoto was enshrined at {{ill|Hachiman Shrine (Q134927474)|Q134927474|qid=Q134927474|lt=Kisami (present Hachiman Shrine, merged Mishima Shrine)}}; and his child Monoi-na-no-Mikoto was enshrined at {{ill|Wakamiya Shrine (Q134930669)|Q134930669|qid=Q134930669|lt=Minato (present Wakamiya Shrine)}}<ref name="gen"/><ref name="engi"/>.

In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 16 ({{ill|1883|Q7816|qid=Q7816}}), it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|qid=Q134917316}}<ref name="gen"/><ref name="engi"/>.
